BATTLE_MATCH_0.notes: Match HUD fn 0x253410, 0x256150-0x2564f0. Each bubble is shown when its flag is set: Pin [0x59e7e0]/[0x59e7e4] (P1/P2), Return [0x59e7e8]/[0x59e7ec], Tag [0x59e7f0]/[0x59e7f4]. Pin and Return use the SAME screen position (32,68 / 540,68), so they are never meant to show together; Tag has its own spot. Pass 1 (0x256150-0x256308) draws the bubbles at full alpha with CSA 9/7/8 (0x305388 -> 0x304678 reg 6). Pass 2 (0x25630c-0x2564f0) sets RGBAQ alpha = 8 * tri(frame, 16) (0x3036f8: 0..16..0 over 32 frames, so 0..128) and draws the v=80 glow sprite of each bubble at exactly the same xy and size, on top: the glow is not offset, it is an overlay that pulses. Sprites 1:1 via 0x303c80/0x303ee8, region-clamped. P1: the Pin bubble (32..104) ends exactly where Tag (104..160) starts - they abut with no gap; Return (32..96) leaves 8 px. P2: Tag 468..524, Pin/Return from 540 (16 px gap). Rect statics gp-0x2558/-0x2548 (Pin), -0x2538/-0x2528 (Return), -0x2518/-0x2508 (Tag), filled 0x255eb0-0x256148 from 0x599ec0..0x599f08.

BATTLE_MM_PT0_0.notes: Tags: fn 0x29efc0(x, y, k, alpha) draws (128+32*min(k,4), 204, 32, 24) 1:1 at (x, y+2). Callers 0x263918/0x263994/0x263ad0 (fn 0x263718, one per member k=0..4) and 0x2b6304 (fn 0x2b62c8) all pass x = 0x130 = 304; y = 0x29dcd8(table 0x10a6fd0, k, side) = [table+0] + k*36 (k*28 when the row state is 13..17). The base y is runtime data (not resolved). In the alternative branch the same spot shows an icon (fn 0x29f0c8, 32x24, x 304) instead of the tag. Each tag is its own 32x24 sprite in its own row; rows are 36 (or 28) apart, so tags never touch each other (12 / 4 px gaps). Name bars (fn 0x29ea20, 308x28, from this picture) are drawn by fn 0x263240 at the row x,y; the row x is animated by fn 0x29df60 between -308, 166, 332 and 640 (slide in/out; 332..640 is the right half), so the tag column x 304..335 sits between a left bar ending at x<=308 and a right bar starting at 332 - exact adjacency not resolved. Alpha comes from the row (fade).

BATTLE_MMAKE_0.notes: Convention: negative wh = mirrored, the quad runs left/up from xy. Widget draw 0x2bb108 (texture object 0x106ddd8). Slot table 0x4edf20 (x, y, scale%): front (232,80,100), right (350,124,80), left (142,124,80); items rotate through the slots on selection (0x2bacc8 rotates the per-item slot index at widget+0x78+16i and copies the slot x/y/scale into widget+0x7c..0x84). Icon: top-left (x,y), size 176*scale/100, colour 128*scale/100 (0x2bb3e4..0x2bb438). Label: size (lw,lh)*scale/100, centred on the icon centre (0x2bb860-0x2bb8ec). Current item: label uses v-48 (selected row); in modes 3/4 (rotating) the unselected row is drawn first and the selected row on top with alpha [sp+0x170] = 128 - 32*min(c, 8-c), c = rotation counter [widget+0x1c0] 0..8 (0x2bb500-0x2bb55c): the selected row dips to 0 mid-rotation and returns - a cross-fade. Non-current items: unselected row (v 224), scaled 80%. Corners (0,176,88,88) frame the current icon, each quarter = half the icon size, mirrored by negative screen sizes. All draws scaled (0x304248), region-clamped. Draw order farthest first, current last; slot assignment of the two side items (which goes left) is likely, not verified. Positions between slots may be interpolated during the rotation (not traced).

SYS_MMAKE3_0.notes: Draw 0x2bb108 (called from 0x2a7828), items set up by 0x2baba8 from tables 0x4df858 (x, y, scale% floats), 0x4df8b8 (tile uv, label uv), 0x4df8f8 (sizes). Every draw is spr4 (0x304248), scaled: tile size int(176*scale/100) at (x,y) (top-left); label size int(w*scale/100) x int(48*scale/100), centred on the tile centre (x+t/2, y+t/2). RGB is modulated by int(scale*128/100) ("tint", 128 = unchanged), so back items are darker; alpha 0x80 normally. Items are drawn back to front: the item opposite the cursor first, the selected one last. Selected item: cursor frame (880,0,88,88) as four mirrored quarters around the tile, label from the highlighted row (v-48). In states 3/4 (0x1c8) the normal label is drawn first and the highlighted one on top with a pulsing alpha (128 - pulse). Positions: at init item k is in slot k (verified, sel 0). For other selections item k in slot (k-sel) mod 8 is *likely* (the update rotates the per-item floats at this+0x7c; not traced). Animation: on a cursor move every item slides (x, y and scale interpolated) between neighbouring slots; on entry (states 1/2) alpha fades in (0x1c0*16). Label sizes are integers (truncation), positions too; the GS then scales texels with bilinear filtering if enabled (not checked), so edge texels of the neighbouring rect can bleed.

Column u 192 is uv (192, 80+40*value) at (264, y) - page 1 rows y 80/240/280, page 2 rows y 80 (uv 360+40v) and 160. Third column: byte 7 of the settings: 1 -> (0,440,192,40) at (240,120), else (336, 80+40v) at (264,120). (336,120,144,40) (FINISHERS) is therefore never drawn, and (192,120) and (336,120) are never side by side: the STEREO cell is shown alone at (264,80) on page 1.
